title: Asha-O-Bhalobasa
desc: Bijoy is jailed after being framed by Bilas Dutta, a famous businessman, and unable to deal with it, his sister commits suicide. When he is released from prison, Bijoy vows to seek revenge.

title: Sultan: The Saviour
desc: Raja Dutta and his sister Disha move to Kolkata to start afresh. But Disha is oblivious to Raja's past and his intention behind shifting to Kolkata.

title: Beder Meye Josna
desc: A prince, bitten by a snake, is saved by the healer Josna, who falls ill in the process. Recovered, she demands his hand in marriage, leading to a royal tug-of-war for love.

title: Sindoor Niye Khela
desc: Varsha is a powerful businesswoman, but faces opposition from her workers. In order to solve the problem, she marries the leader of the workers' union.

title: Ashirbad
desc: Brijlal, a cunning entrepreneur, plots to kill his partner and his son. However, the son survives and years later, ends up falling in love with Brijlal's daughter.

title: Maha Sati Sabitri
desc: After years of praying, King Ashvapati is blessed with a daughter, Savitri. Years later, she refuses to renege on her engagement to a terminally ill prince and decides to save his life through prayer.

title: Kolkatar Harry
desc: A hardcore Harry Potter fan, Harinath, embarks on a magical adventure of his own when he loses his job as a carpool driver.

title: Bancharamer Bagan
desc: Bancharam, a poor peasant, turns his barren land into a thriving garden, only to face a cunning landlord who stops at nothing to take it away from him.

title: Patanjali Yog - By Yogrishi Swami Ramdev
desc: Baba Ramdev emphasises the importance of yoga and demonstrates various asanas and breathing exercises that enable one to lead a healthy and stress-free life.

title: Palasher Biye
desc: Before her death, Palash's grandmother wants him to get married. But as fate would have it, he falls in love with Shalini, whose values differ from his traditional joint family culture.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Skilled artists and singers enchant audiences with popular Bengali devotional and folk songs, celebrating the rich musical heritage.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Ostad
desc: Sanjay and Mili, two college goers, fall in love with each other. Their fathers are business rivals and this creates various problems in their lives.
